The release comes following the club's contract renewal with the Italian brand earlier this summer. The Pontevedra 26-27 home shirt embraces the club's traditional granate (maroon) base, elevated with subtle gold diagonal radiating lines across the chest and a classic polo collar. It is paired with navy blue shorts and maroon socks with gold and navy accents. Meanwhile, the away kit introduces a fresh mint cyan look complemented by matching tonal graphics, trim detailing, and full mint shorts and socks. Completing the set is a vibrant bright pink goalkeeper uniform.
